plain: Merrick von Renenamp, a researcher, says he has read the raw case files of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. He describes them as the straight reports, with no analysis added. He raises this on a podcast episode about a debate with a UFO skeptic named Mick West, to make the point that the original reports, read on their own, tell a different story than the official conclusions.
